settings.name: USE_REVERSE_SCAN
settings.description: **Enable Reverse Scan:** Set to `yes` to enable scanning of clients ports.

settings.name: REVERSE_SCAN_PORTS
settings.description: **Ports to Scan:** Space-separated list of ports to check on the client side.

settings.name: REVERSE_SCAN_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Scan Timeout:** Maximum time in milliseconds allowed for scanning a port. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is milliseconds.
